title: Tiny, cute rainbow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='r1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4d6d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='r2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9e3d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc078'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='r3' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe94d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff59e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='r4' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ce65c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8f0a8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='r5' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4db8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9bd8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='r6' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9b6bff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c9b0ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer red arch -->
  <path d='M10 84 A40 40 0 0 1 90 84 L82 84 A32 32 0 0 0 18 84 Z' fill='url(#r1)'/>
  <!-- orange -->
  <path d='M18 84 A32 32 0 0 1 82 84 L75 84 A25 25 0 0 0 25 84 Z' fill='url(#r2)'/>
  <!-- yellow -->
  <path d='M25 84 A25 25 0 0 1 75 84 L68 84 A18 18 0 0 0 32 84 Z' fill='url(#r3)'/>
  <!-- green -->
  <path d='M32 84 A18 18 0 0 1 68 84 L61 84 A11 11 0 0 0 39 84 Z' fill='url(#r4)'/>
  <!-- blue -->
  <path d='M39 84 A11 11 0 0 1 61 84 L55 84 A5 5 0 0 0 45 84 Z' fill='url(#r5)'/>
  <!-- purple inner core -->
  <path d='M45 84 A5 5 0 0 1 55 84 L51 84 A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 49 84 Z' fill='url(#r6)'/>
  <!-- cute face on the yellow band -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='76' rx='2.4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='76' rx='2.4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='75' r='0.8' fill='#fff59e'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='75' r='0.8' fill='#fff59e'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='80' rx='2.6' ry='1.8' fill='#ff7aa2'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='80' rx='2.6' ry='1.8' fill='#ff7aa2'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M47 79 Q50 82 53 79' stroke='#3a2a00' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tiny rainbow tail puffs -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='88' r='4' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='88' r='4' fill='#c9b0ff'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='90' r='2.2' fill='#ffc078'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='90' r='2.2' fill='#9bd8ff'/>
</svg>
